elements.text: 1 How long does the battery last?
Most Atlas batteries keep at least 80 percent of their capacity after 500 full charge cycles. Range depends on riding mode, weather, and load.
2 Is my battery covered by warranty?
Yes. Every Atlas battery has a warranty. The length depends on the model and when you bought it; check the warranty policy for your bike or ask your dealer.
3 Can I ride in the rain?
Yes. Atlas bikes are built for rain, but don't submerge them and don't use a pressure washer.
4 What if I forget my PIN?
Visit an authorized dealer with your proof of purchase. They can set a new PIN without erasing your ride history.
A single blink usually means low battery. Other patterns point to a fault; your dealer can read the error code.
Only use the approved Atlas charger for your model. Other chargers can damage the battery and are not covered by the warranty.
7 How often should I service my bike?
We recommend a service every year, or more often if you ride a lot. Your dealer will check brakes, chain, and battery health.
